name: DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.augment_nodup
typeText:
∀ {ν : Type} [inst : DecidableEq.{1} ν] (N : DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network ν),
  DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.Ok N →
    ∀ (U : List.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} ν ν)) (p : List.{0} ν),
      List.Nodup.{0} U →
        (∀ (a : Prod.{0, 0} ν ν),
            Membership.mem.{0, 0} U a → Membership.mem.{0, 0} (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.arcs N) a) →
          List.Nodup.{0} p →
            List.IsChain.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.ResL N U) p →
              List.Nodup.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.augment N U p)

source.code:
theorem augment_nodup (hN : N.Ok) (U : List (ν × ν)) (p : List ν) (hU : U.Nodup)
    (hsub : ∀ a ∈ U, a ∈ N.arcs) (hp : p.Nodup) (hch : p.IsChain (N.ResL U)) :
    (N.augment U p).Nodup := by
  unfold augment
  rw [List.nodup_append]
  refine ⟨hU.filter _, (steps_nodup hp).filter _, ?_⟩
  intro a ha e he hae
  subst hae
  rw [List.mem_filter] at ha he
  simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at he
  exact N.forward_notMem hN hsub hch he.1 he.2 ha.1
